name: After § 1-Am 27
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text: 1b. Recalls that the Syrian civil war caused a mass exodus of Syrians to neighbouring countries and to Europe; emphasises that the mass arrival of migrants from Syria systematically destabilised the receiving countries because it overwhelmed their social services, dramatically increased criminality rates and antisemitism, and fuelled terrorist attacks;
